pages.name: Old Indian: 3.Nc3 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 prepared ...e5 with ...Re8 before castling and ...Be7 with the e-pawn still on e7. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian: 3.Nc3 Nbd7 4.e4 e5 5.Nge2
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed Be2 with the knight on e2 and wrote castling as 0-0; plan 2 said ...c6 challenges d4 and rerouted the knight via f8 before ...Re8. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian: Ukrainian, Queenswap, 6.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 2 moved the king Ke8-f7 and Ke8-c7 with the king on d8; plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian Defense: Tartakower-Indian
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-pawn blocks) and linked it to e4; plan 3 played g4 onto the bishop. Rewrote overview and plans 2-3.

pages.name: Old Indian Defense: Tartakower-Indian
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin; plan 4 recaptured gxf3 before Black had taken and called the g-file open. Rewrote overview and plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian Defense: Ukrainian Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 put White's moves and ...Kxd8+ inside a Black plan; plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian: 4.Nf3 e4
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted a knight Ng1-e2-f4 that is already on f3 and under attack. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian: 5.Bg5 Be7 6.e3
pages.notes: Overview and plan 3 described a Bg5 pin that the e7-bishop blocks and a ...c5 break; plan 1 played Re1 before castling; plan 3 played ...g5 onto the bishop. Rewrote overview and all three plans.

pages.name: Old Indian: 5.e3
pages.notes: Plan 1 read d3 as a move and called queenside expansion a minority attack; plan 4 rerouted a b8-knight that is already on d7. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 (reviewer rejection of the knight route fixed and re-reviewed).

pages.name: Old Indian: 5.g3
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote ...a5-b5 as one move; plan 4 routed ...Nf8-g6 with the bishop and rook on f8. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.
